title: MFA Method Removed Before Suspicious Login
content: Identity provider audit logs show an actor removing the only MFA method from a user account. Within one hour the user signs in from a new device and accesses cloud storage.

expected.threat_summary: MFA is removed from a user account before suspicious follow-on access.
key_behaviors: MFA or authentication method is removed
successful login follows from unfamiliar device
hunt_checklist: Review identity audit logs for MFA disable/authentication method removal/security info changes.
Identify actor, target user, source IP, device, user agent, and application.
Review successful logins and sensitive access after the MFA change.
expected.correlation_logic: Correlate MFA method changes by actor and target user with follow-on login, device, source IP, session, and cloud access.
expected.escalation_condition: Escalate when MFA is removed without approved workflow or suspicious access follows.
expected.analyst_notes: Hand-authored external gold standard case for accuracy/generalization evaluation.
